rows.Product: Alfalfa Sprouts
rows.Reason: Multistate outbreak of Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (serotypes O26:H11, O103:H25 and O168:H8) and Salmonella Agona linked to alfalfa sprouts distributed by Everything Sprouts, LLC. As of 24 August 2026, 55 illnesses across 15 U.S. states had been reported, including four hospitalisations and no deaths. Of the 55 reported cases, 46 involved STEC only, seven involved Salmonella Agona only, and two involved coinfection with both pathogens
rows.Notes: FDA listing HTML (Layer 1) [outbreak flag corrected 2026-08-26: FDA's recall notice of 22 August 2026 states '55 reports of illnesses have been received by federal and state partners related to alfalfa sprouts', and FDA runs a matching investigation page, 'Outbreak Investigation of Shiga Toxin-producing E. coli & Salmonella: Sprouts (August 2026)'. The row was published with the outbreak flag unset; it is set on 2026-08-26 on the strength of the illness count in FDA's own notice.] [corrected 2026-08-28, verified against the FDA outbreak investigation page (as of 08/24/2026): 55 illnesses across 15 states (FL, IN, IA, KS, MI, MN, NH, NY, NC, ND, PA, SC, SD, WA, WI), 4 hospitalisations, 0 deaths; 46 infected with E. coli, 7 with Salmonella, 2 with both. Serotypes O26:H11, O103:H25, O168:H8 plus Salmonella Agona. Firm Everything Sprouts, LLC; brands Calco and Everything Sprouts; direct distribution MN and WI only. Pathogen set to STEC as the dominant hazard (46 of 55 cases) to keep the column canonical - the co-pathogen is named in Reason, not compounded into the controlled vocabulary. URL repointed from the company recall notice to the FDA outbreak investigation, which carries the epidemiology; the recall notice was https://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/everything-sprouts-llc-recalls-alfalfa-sprouts-due-potential-e-coli-and-salmonella-risk]
